description: This file is a shell script designed for testing Git's handling of line ending conversions, attributes, and warnings related to CRLF and LF line endings. It defines multiple test functions, creates various test files with different line endings, sets up Git attributes, and performs numerous checks to ensure correct behavior under different configurations.

methods.name: compare_files
methods.description: Compares two files after transforming line endings and content, used to verify file integrity after conversion.

methods.name: compare_ws_file
methods.description: Compares two files with special transformations to verify consistency in line endings and content.

methods.name: create_gitattributes
methods.description: Creates a .gitattributes file with specified attributes for testing.

methods.name: create_NNO_MIX_files
methods.description: Generates test files with various line endings and attributes, used for testing in different scenarios.

methods.name: check_warning
methods.description: Checks warning messages for line ending conversions during Git operations.

methods.name: commit_check_warn
methods.description: Performs commit operations with various attributes, checking for expected warnings.

methods.name: commit_chk_wrnNNO
methods.description: Sets up environment and commits files with specific attributes and checks for warnings.

methods.name: commit_MIX_chkwrn
methods.description: Commits files with mixed line endings and checks for specific warnings.

methods.name: stats_ascii
methods.description: Translates internal line ending states to human-readable ASCII descriptions.

methods.name: attr_ascii
methods.description: Converts Git eol attribute values to human-readable forms.

methods.name: check_files_in_repo
methods.description: Verifies that files in the repository match expected line endings and content after certain operations.

methods.name: check_in_repo_NNO
methods.description: Checks that files in the repository with NNO settings match expected content.

methods.name: checkout_files
methods.description: Simulates checking out files with different attribute and configuration settings, verifying their final content and line endings.
